get.description: Returns `ProjectStats` for each project the authenticated user is a member of. Same query semantics as `GET /api/agent/projects/summary` for users (`projectId`, `scope`, `include`, `workspace`, `listWorkspaces`).

parameters.description: When set, return at most this project if the user is a member.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Task counting scope. `main` excludes workspace children (parentId IS NULL). `all` counts every task. `workspace:{containerTaskId|identifier|title}` scopes to one workspace.

parameters.name: listWorkspaces
parameters.description: When true, include workspace container digests (same as `include=workspaces`).

get.summary: Get tasks for project or all accessible tasks
get.description: With projectId: get tasks for a specific project. Without projectId: get all tasks the user has access to (My Tasks). Returns paginated results. Use `noColumn=true` and `archived=false` for backlog lists; `archived=true` for archived tasks. Archived tasks are excluded from `GET /api/projects/{id}/board` column payloads.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Project ID (optional - if omitted, returns all accessible tasks)

parameters.name: assigneeIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to filter by assignee

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: When `true`, return only archived tasks (`archivedAt` set). When `false`, exclude archived tasks.

parameters.name: noColumn
parameters.description: When `true`, return only tasks with no column assignment (`projectColumnId` is null).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query with optional field:value syntax

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Optional project ID to limit search to a specific project

get.description: Returns projects accessible to the authenticated agent or user. Agents see projects they've been delegated to with their permission levels. Users see their own projects with their roles.

Returns lightweight per-project task and column counts without task bodies. Agents see active delegations; users see all membership projects. Platform agents may call when the route is on their read allowlist and a user-scoped platform session is present.

Query params `scope`, `include`, `workspace`, and `listWorkspaces` are part of the contract for Phase 2 stats; only `projectId` is enforced today.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: When set, return at most this project if accessible.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Task counting scope. `main` excludes workspace children (parentId IS NULL). `all` counts every task. Phase 2: also `workspace:{containerTaskId}`.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Container task identifier or unique title for single-workspace scope. Phase 2.

parameters.name: listWorkspaces
parameters.description: When true, include workspace container digests (same as `include=workspaces`). Phase 2.

get.description: Returns lightweight stats for one accessible project without task bodies. Requires project access.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated optional stat buckets: documents, agentReview, helpRequests, blocked, workspaces, workspaces:all.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Container identifier or title for workspace-scoped summary (reserved).

bearerAuth.description: Enter the JWT token received from login/register endpoints

agentAuth.name: x-agent-api-key
agentAuth.description: Agent API key authentication using the x-agent-api-key header. Provide the raw key value (for example: ag_xxx). Agents must have active delegations to access projects.

platformSession.name: x-platform-session
platformSession.description: Platform agent JWT session token obtained from POST /api/agent/session. Required for write operations (PATCH, POST, DELETE) by platform agents.

UserRole.description: User's system role: USER (default), SUPPORT (elevated), ADMIN (full access)

UserPermissions.description: User's system-level permissions based on their role

isAdmin.description: Whether the user has admin privileges

canManageRateLimits.description: Whether the user can manage rate limit configurations

canManageUsers.description: Whether the user can manage user roles

ProjectColumnStats.description: Per-column task counts in a project stats payload

taskCountMain.description: Phase 2: tasks with parentId IS NULL in this column

taskCountAll.description: Phase 2: all tasks in this column regardless of parentId

formalityLevel.description: FORMAL when project has a description, else LIGHTWEIGHT

BoardResponse.description: Complete board data with columns, tasks, and members

TaskMonitorPass.description: Monitor pass record for a task in a column

TaskDocumentLink.description: Link between a task and a document. When ?inline=true is used, the nested 'document' field is populated.

UpdateTaskRequest.description: Partial task update (PATCH). Send `projectColumnId: 0` or omit column to clear assignment (backlog). Setting a column clears archive unless `archived: true`.

projectColumnId.description: Target column id; use 0 or null to move task to backlog (no column)

archived.description: When true, sets archivedAt (hidden from board). When false, clears archive.

relationId.description: Related task ID for task relations

parentId.description: Workspace container task id for child membership
Parent task ID for sub-board hierarchy (one tier only)

planAccepted.description: Whether the implementation plan for this container task has been accepted

subBoardOutlineColor.description: Hex color code for sub-board outline on card UI

archivedAt.description: When set, task is archived and excluded from board column payloads

childCount.description: Number of child tasks (for container tasks)

docLinks.description: Document links for task dialog cards (Knowledge Hub integration)
